q: Why give each track a fixed role?
a: Levels and exports stay predictable, and another editor finds their way at once. Typical: V1 main, V2 B-roll, V3 graphics; A1–A2 dialogue, A3 music, A4 effects, routed to submixes.

q: Later, how can I prove a backup copy of my footage is still intact?
a: Use the checksum list made by the verified card copy: it lets you verify any copy later.

q: Is lowering the playback resolution a good alternative to proxies?
a: As a quick fix while cutting, yes; the trade-off is a softer picture while playing. Proxies suit heavy camera files and the render cache suits heavy grades and effects.
